purpose: Define one leakage-resistant evaluation bench on which all real-data baselines and later candidate architectures must be compared.

temporal_contract.decision_timestamp_enforcement: reject any feature whose timestamp proof exceeds prediction timestamp

point_in_time_reconstruction.race_card_profile: use only historically published values demonstrably available before decision cutoff
point_in_time_reconstruction.line_structure: use timestamped/preserved PRE structure only; do not reconstruct from post-race narrative
point_in_time_reconstruction.weather: observed-before-cutoff only; forecast is not truth
point_in_time_reconstruction.market: only timestamp-proven odds snapshots at or before the model's declared decision cutoff

candidate_comparison_rule: All candidate models receive the same eligible race universe, cutoff semantics, split object, scoring code, and missingness policy. Architecture-specific exclusions require predeclared reasons and separate reporting.
promotion_rule: No model promotion is authorized here. Any future promotion criterion must be prespecified before untouched final evaluation and may not be based on ROI alone.
implementation_readiness_checks: schema can express available_at for every feature
all dataset rows bind to race_id and prediction_timestamp
duplicate and series identifiers are available or conservatively constructed
split manifest is immutable and content-addressed
scoring does not import settlement or payout modules
next_gate: Build a source-safe schema/harness against non-protected toy or synthetic rows first; bind real point-in-time source availability separately before any real backtest execution.
